tei:div.tei:p: 293) ༄༅/ klong chen snying gi thig le'i cha lag sa nad bra ba'i gnod pa zhi ba'i las rim phan bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 294)

༄༅/ mtshan gyi me tog yid kyi mtshor// bkod pa'i mod la blo yi dbul// ming med bsal mdzad kun mkhyen rje// yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud// yum ka'i las tshogs la brten nas// bra ba'i gnod pa zhi ba'i thabs// brgyud ldan mgon gyi gsung rab las// btus nas bklag chog 'jug bder spel/ 'dir yum ka'i las tshogs bcu bdun pa dang*/ tshe ring ma'i las tshogs gung sbrel te sa nad bra ba'i gnod pa zhi ba'i las rim la/ sbyor ba yo byad bshams tshul ni/ gang du bya ba'i gzhir yum ka'i rtsa gtor dang*/ ma mgon lcam dral/ tshe ring ma'i gtor ma rnams dang*/ skong bshags rdo rje thol glu'i gtor ma/ sman phud/ rakta/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sbreng tshar bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ dkar bgegs/ chad brten/ chos skyong gtor 'bul/ bsang gi gtor ma rgyas par phud rab chen mo bzhin ma grub tshe/ bsang phyer bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa gang mang dang*/ snod gcig tu sa spyin las/ gnam 'gong bya mgo g.yas su bar 'gong sprel mgo g.yon du sa 'gong bra mgo gsum ka gcer bu ral pa gyen brdzes dor stabs can/ lag na ral gri zhags pa/ mchan la nad rkyal can la chang bu ting lo/ nam rgyang mda' 'phang sogs yas rdzas ci 'byor bskor/ dam bsgrag dkar dmar bye ma 'thor rgyu bcas 'du bya'o/ dngos gzhi la/ sems bskyed sdom chog dang*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ 295) sku gsum gsol 'debs/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= sogs dang*/ yum ka'i brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ dkar bgegs/ bka' bsgo srung 'khor/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol/ phyag mchod bstod pa yan zin nas/ dzapra dmigs ni/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng : dpag med gnon ma gur gum mdog: zhabs gnyis rta babs skyil mo krung: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: dkon mchog gsum mtshon skyabs sbyin rgyas:

utpal la gnas mchod rten 'dzin: thugs ka'i hūm̐ḥlas 'od 'phros hūm̐: zhabs gnyis sa la brdabs pa yis: stong gsum pha rol gnas pa'i ri: mandha ra dang 'bigs byed dang: 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med ldeg: drag shul stobs kyis dmigs bya'i gzugs: zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bsam: oṃ padmo yo gi ni tā re hūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ ho swa hā: zhes bzlas stong phrag tsam song nas/ mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang dang*/ las byang gi mchod bstod yig brgya bcas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas/ sogs nas/ g.yo ba nyid ma/ zhes brgya tsharabarjod/ bzlas dmigs/ thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la tāṃ yig bkod pa'i mtha' bskor 296)sngags phreng las mthun gyi 'od zer 'phros pas sa nad bra ba'i gnod pa rmeg med du zhi bar bsam mo/ de nas bsang rdzas bsreg cing sbar la/ hrīḥ snang srid rnam dag dbyings phyug ma'i: sogs nas/ bran pas nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ de nas bsang dngos ni/ kyai/ kun tu bzang po nas bzung ste// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// dgongs brda snyan nas brgyud pa yi// bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang*// bdag gis bsrung ba'i yul phyogs 'dir// bra ba'i gnod pa zhi nas kyang*// sa bcud 'phel zhing rtsa kha rgyas// yul phyogs bkra shis bde legs stsol// 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul rgyud// sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad sogs// zhi dang khro bo rab 'byams lha'i// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bsang*// bdag gis= sogs shlau ka 'gres/ rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang*// zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos// tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ste// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum bsang*// bdag gis= legs ldan tshogs bdag phyag bzhi pa// ma ning stag zhon bing gri gug /seng zhon trag shad lags pa'i// pho rgyud mgon po thams cad bsang*// bdag gis = sngags srung nag mo ral gcig ma// tshe ring mched lnga re ma ti// srog sgrub zhing

297)skyong ma mo sogs// mo rgyud lha mo thams cad bsang*// bdag gis srung ba'i yul phyogs 'dir// bra ba'i gnod pa zhi nas kyang*// sa bcud 'phel zhing rtswa kha rgyas// yul phyogs bkra shis bde legs stsol/ khyab 'jug rdor legs tsi'u dmar// sde dpon sum cu pe ha ra// sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad sogs// mthu chen dregs pa thams cad bsang*// bdag gis= rnam thos sras sogs rgyal chen bzhi// phyogs skyong lha klu gza' skar dang*// 'jigs byed dgu dang ma sring sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la// bdag gis= phyi nang gsang ba gab sbas dang*// bstan skyong rtag cing chags pa sogs// snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma srin// sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa bsang*// bdag gis= bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// rje 'bangs mgul lha srog lha sogs// dben nas chos 'khor srung ma dang*// yul lha gzhi dag thams cad bsang*// bdag gis= mdor na mchod par 'os pa'i mgron// gang mchis ming du ma 'tshal bas// bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa 'dis// bsang shing mchod do dgyes par mdzod// bdag gis= dkon mchog gsum gyis bden pa dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus// bra ba'i gnod pa nyer zhi 298) nas// rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ ces pas bsang mchod brgya rtsa ma grub par bskyar/ de nas bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral nas gsol ka yongs rdzogs btang ba'i tshe ring ma'i skong ba brgya tshar bsags pa'i rjes su/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od zer drwa ba rab 'phros pas// sman btsun 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul// 'dod don mngon du sgrub par gyur/ zhes dmigs la tshe ring ma'i rtsa sngags stong rtsa dang*/ las sbyor bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badzra pra mo ha sing ha mu kha he: gnod byed bra ba'i lus ngag yid gsum rmug sha rmug sha rbad: thuṃ ril rbad: badzra kha thaṃ: trignaṃ:

zhes 'di kho nar thun gzung*/ bye ma la sngags/ thun mthar bskang ba grangs ci rigs dang*/ rgyal dbang padma= sogs nas/ mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa sol: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*/ khros shing 'khrugs pa bskang gyur nas// nad sprin mtshon gru kha rlangs zer// bra ba'i gnod pa dbyings su bsdus// mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ ces kha bsgyur ba dang*/ g.yu sgron man btang la/ gser skyems sku gsum= mar/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bra ba'i gnod pa ma gtong zhig ces bsgyur ba brgya tsam bsag na raka skong bshags dang*/ yum ka'i tshogs/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ 299) drang lhag zin pa dang*/ glud bsngo ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir// tri yig gsum po yongs gyur las/ dbus su gnam 'gong bya yi mgo /g.yas su bar 'gong sprel mgo dang*// g.yon du sa 'gong bra mgo can// gsum ka gcer bu dor stabs tshul// dmar nag ral pa gyen du gzings// lag tu ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// 'khor du 'gong po spun dgu dang*// bse rag ltogs 'gong dam sri'i rigs// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i tshogs// lan chags bdag po dpag med gas// thugs ka'i 'od kyis mgron rnams bkug /bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par gyur/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// chos nyid chas can bden pa'i mthus// gnod byed thams cad 'dir khug cig haṃ shaṃ tri sarba bighnaṃ aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes 'gugs pa bdun nam nyer gcig dang*/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe zhe sdang las bsags pas// 'dre yi lus blangs gzhan la 'tshe/ phyi ma na raka gnas su ltung*// bskal pa'i bar du thar dus med// 'gyod pa'i sems bskyed gzhan gnod spongs// dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' la nyon// lan chags 300) glud gtor 'di bzhes la// byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzod/

de nas yas rdzas rnams bsham/ rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang*// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral ba yi// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ saṃ bha ra= lan gsum/ glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di// gnam sa bar gsum 'gong po dang*// bse rag ltogs 'gong dam sri'i rigs// lan chags bdag po rnams la sbyin// yul 'dir bra ba'i gnod ma gtong*// rtswa kha rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ zhes pa'i mtshan bzhi man chad brgya dang brgyad bar bskyar/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// gdug pa'i sems spongs byang sems bskyed// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /bdag gis srung ba'i yul phyogs 'dir// bra ba'i gnod pa ma gtong zhig /phyugs kyi kha zas ma 'phrog la// rtswa kha legs pa'i phrin las sgrubs/ khyed la za ba'i lam bstan pa// snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa yi// bstan la sdang ba'i dam nyams dang*// bla mar smod cing sku la bsdo// dge 'dun dkor la rlom pa yi// las ngan dam log a mu ka'i// sa cha yul la za lam ston// gtan gyi bzhugs gnas de 301)ru gyis// mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di snoms la// lan chags bu lon byang bar mdzod/ ces brjod/ 'di'i rgyab skyor du kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos mdzad pa'i phud rab rgyal brngan dang bcas pa/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i bsang brngan sbyin rnams dang*/ gzhan yang yul khrus/ snang brgyad/ nyes sel/ sa snying mdo/ sde brgyad/ khengs log bcos pa/ sa bdag 'khrugs bcos rnams dang tshabs che na byang gter 'gong po ar gtad rnams la nan tan bya'o/ de nas chos skyong gtor 'bul gzhung gi thugs dam bskul pa dang*/ chad tho'i rjes su/ dkar dmar la me sgron btsugs te lha srin la dam bsgrags pa ni / hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// slob dpon padma thod phreng gis// dam la btags pa'i lha 'dre rnams// chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon// gdong mar bod kyi rgyal khams su// lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags// bdag ni slob dpon de yi brgyud/

khyed ni lha 'dre g.yar dam can// sngon tshe khas blangs bka' ma gcog /da lta rig 'dzin dam ma dbral// dkar phyogs dkar gsum mchod pa dang*// nag phyogs dmar gtor rgyan ldan bzhes// bdag gis srung ba'i yul phyogs 'dir// bra ba'i gnod pa ma gtong zhig phyugs kyi kha zas ma 'phrog la/ 302) /rtsa kha legs pa'i phrin las sgrubs// gal te bka' las 'das pa na// dam tshig gnyen po'i chad pas bsdigs// de bas dam la ma 'da' bar/ bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ ces brjod la gtor ma gnod pa byung ba'i phyogs su bskyal/ nub snga ma rnams su brtan ma bskyang*/ rta bro bya/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ dge bsngo/ smon lam/ bkra shis/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam rnams kyis mtha' brgyan no/ nub rjes mar/ dam bsgrags zin nas/ mdos bran la gshegs su gsol ba ni/ kyai/ nyon cig gdon gyi sde tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin bzang pos tshim gyis la// nyi ma de ring phyin chad nas// gnas 'dir ma 'tshe ma gnod par// sdang byed dgra yi yul du song*// bka' dang dam las 'das pa na// rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdul du brlag par gdon mi za// de bas so so rang gnas su// da lta nyid du 'gro bar gyis/ sum bha na ི'i drag sngags dang*/ gu gul bdug yungs thun dang bye ma brab/ rol mo'i mtshams rngams drag po dang bcas yas glud rnams shin tu rgyang ring por bskyal/ phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs la springs ba'i gtam gnod sbyin gyi rna cha sogs brjod/ srung 'khor dmigs pa bcas gzhung gi 'don tshig hrīḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams la: sogs kyi srung 'khor 303) dang*/ bshal chus brtan ma skyong*/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs la rta bro brdung*/ rjes chog mchod bstod dang*/ nongs pa bshag dngos grub len/ rten la brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdus la rang babs gshis kyi gnas lugs sgrib bral nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu la ngang bzhag chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis cung zad gzhag

slar yang sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang la/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo smon dang*/ bkra shis kyi snang bas sa gsum khyab pas dge legs su bya'o/ bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi lam 'dir brtson na 'dod don yid bzhin du grub pa la the tshom med pas gzhan phan kho na dang du len par rigs so/ stong gsum me 'obs kyis gang yang*// brgal nas btsal bya dam pa'i chos// klong chen snying thig zab lam 'di// tshe rabs kun tu 'dzin nus shog ces pa'ang rang gzhan kun la nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te dpe rgyun snga ma rnams su phyogs 'dir lung mi bzhugs pas man ngag gi bcud dril nas khyer bde'i slad du sbas lung bkra shis ra bar bsam gtan 'od gsal gling gi gtsug lag khang du mang du thos shing*/ rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig dge'o// 304)
